description: A single-expression arm body whose line ends in `+` continues onto the next line (§7.2.2 rule 2): `.Boom(m) :> "a:" +⏎ m` is one arm.
rationale: §7.2.2 "Arm heads": "A single-expression arm body (`.A :> expr`) ends at its line break unless the line ends in a continuation token (rule 2)"; `+` is on rule 2's closed list. (The bootstrap split this arm — dpa-068 D12.)
